findings.message: The verification evidence marks D-STORY:AC-004 as verified with no tagged test, while the approved specification and plan require visual acceptance at representative desktop and tablet widths. It does not contain desktop/tablet screenshots or a source-bound visual witness, so the recorded verification status is unsupported.
WIT-001's initial-screen capture shows cos(x) * x rather than the specification's required initial sin(x), so it contradicts the claimed AC-001 visual evidence.
WIT-002 shows the calculator keypad rather than a plotted circle; it does not visually demonstrate the circle centered at (0, 0) with radius six units.
WIT-003 duplicates the calculator keypad screenshot and contains no updated graph, so the claimed expression-update visual evidence is absent.
WIT-004 shows the calculator keypad at desktop/tablet sizes, not the graph area or its controls; it cannot establish graph usability at the required widths.
